instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: Some people find it unbelievable that not everyone can speak English.
atoms.b: Some people find it ((unbelievable)) that not everyone can speak English.

atoms.a: Even though the doctors performed several medical tests, they were unsuccessful in diagnosing the disease.
atoms.b: Even though the doctors performed several medical tests, they were ((unsuccessful)) in diagnosing the disease.

atoms.a: The future of the space mission was uncertain after the astronaut got sick.
atoms.b: The future of the space mission was ((uncertain)) after the astronaut got sick.

atoms.a: They had a mischievous smile on their faces after they came up with their secret plan.
atoms.b: They had a ((mischievous)) smile on their faces after they came up with their secret plan.

atoms.a: He woke up to the unmistakable sound of coffee beans being ground.
atoms.b: He woke up to the ((unmistakable)) sound of coffee beans being ground.

atoms.a: The weather in England is quite inconsistent; it changes quickly.
atoms.b: The weather in England is quite ((inconsistent)); it changes quickly.

atoms.a: After a successful advertising campaign on London buses, the company’s sales began to increase.
atoms.b: After a successful advertising campaign on London buses, the company’s sales began to ((increase)).

atoms.a: The police will inquire about the crime from last night.
atoms.b: The police will ((inquire)) about the crime from last night.

parentBlock.title: Spelling Practice (4) - unbelievable, unsuccessful, uncertain, unmistakable, mischievous, inconsistent, increase, inquire
